importSteps.title: Upload Your File
importSteps.description: Navigate to the Imports page in Dawarich and select your file.
details: Data format will be recognized automatically

importSteps.title: Processing
importSteps.description: Dawarich processes your import in the background. Large files may take a few minutes.
details: You'll receive a notification when import is complete

importSteps.title: Data Available
importSteps.description: Once complete, all your imported data appears on your map and in your statistics.
details: View points on the interactive map

exportSteps.title: Go to Points
exportSteps.description: Navigate to the Points page in your Dawarich dashboard.

exportSteps.title: Select Date Range
exportSteps.description: Choose the specific date range for the data you want to export and hit Search.
details: Ensure all desired data is visible

exportSteps.description: Dawarich generates your export file in the background.
details: Large exports may take a few minutes

exportSteps.title: Download
exportSteps.description: Once ready, download your export file.
details: Download link appears on Exports page

importExportPage.heading: Our Data Philosophy
importExportPage.p: Export all your data at any time. You're never trapped—switch to another service or keep your own backup.
importExportPage.p2: Moving from Google Maps Timeline or any other tracker? Import everything easily and pick up where you left off.
importExportPage.p3: Download everything: points, visits, trips, stats, settings. Your complete digital location history belongs to you.
importExportPage.subtitle2: Bring your location data from virtually any source into Dawarich.
importExportPage.subtitle3: Get your historical location data into Dawarich in a few simple steps.
importExportPage.p4: Dawarich automatically prevents duplicate points. Import the same file twice or have your tracking app report the same location—we ensure each unique point is only stored once.
importExportPage.subtitle4: Take your data with you—anywhere, anytime, in any format you need.
importExportPage.subtitle5: Download your location data quickly and securely.
importExportPage.p5: Easily migrate your complete location history from Google Maps Timeline or any other service to Dawarich.
importExportPage.p6: Export your data regularly to create backups. Keep local copies of your entire location history.
importExportPage.p7: Use GPX exports in other GPS software, mapping applications, or import into different platforms.
importExportPage.p8: Start with a free account and import your existing location history today.
importExportPage.p9: 7-day free trial · 14-day risk-free refund · Cancel anytime
